trigger: Triggered by event play_epilogue. Branches on `ending`, then on Theo.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The census board covers a whole wall of the powerhouse. Names in chalk. More every week.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The hospital ward runs on Feeder 3. Elevator 6 is a greenhouse: potatoes, kale, lamps humming.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The council argues every night. Bea calls it democracy. Jory calls it a migraine. Both show up.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: No one is coming. There's a plan for this winter, and a draft for the next one.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Above the board, someone has chalked Lou's words: SOMETHING TERRIBLE HAPPENED. WE DON'T KNOW WHAT. BE KIND.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Kessler runs the motor pool. He has one vote. He says it's the hardest posting he's ever had.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: In March, for eleven minutes, the sun comes through the ash. Nobody says anything. Everybody goes outside.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The list has 412 names. In December the city had nine thousand.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's honest now. Strand reads it aloud every Sunday, including the names she crossed off.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You have a desk. A warm bed. A pencil with an eraser. You use the eraser.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The turbines go north on logging sleds. Behind you, the dam goes dark, then the hospital.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Seven hundred meters down, it's always seven degrees. Mushrooms. Potatoes. Lamps.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: From the Highway 53 overlook you watch Duluth go black, one window at a time.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The spillways roar open. Unit 2 dies with a sound Hank would have hated.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Ruiz's charges are clean. Nobody is hurt. Nobody will ever kill for this room again.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You do it by hand, with a sledge and a breaker bar. It costs you. It's done.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Then the long walk south over the ice, toward camps nobody has seen. Everyone who trusts you comes.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You slip out before dawn with two packs and two coats. Nobody stops you. Nobody notices.

nodes.speaker: wren
nodes.text: [Radio static] ...Sparky? If you hear this, I'm heading for Bayfield. Owe you three. Bye.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: And Theo—

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: ma. exciter, sync, breaker. i still remember. forty-one times.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He walks with a crutch Ray made. He races it anyway.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: ASHFALL

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He's with his people now. A letter comes in spring: 'i'm taking my insulin. i promise. — T'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It happened in the cold, in March. You keep his meter in your coat. It still turns on.
